sentences.text: % 15.03.2024 CRL. M. (BAIL) 449/2024 (suspension of sentence, by Appellant)

1. This is an application preferred on behalf of the Appellant under Section 389 Cr.P.C. read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking suspension of sentence and release of the Appellant on bail during the pendency of the present appeal in case FIR No. 1257/2014 under Section 376(2)(i) IPC and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at PS: S.B. Dairy.

sentences.text: 3. Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
4. Status report be filed within a period of four weeks from today.
5. Fresh nominal roll be requisitioned before the next date of hearing.
